title: HR Projects Manager LATAM
description:
Job title: HR Projects Manager LATAM

Location: Bogotá, Mexico City or Sao Paulo

Summary:

The HRBP & Projects Manager LATAM is a hybrid role combining strategic HR business partnering with project management responsibilities across the Latin America region. This position ensures consistent HR governance, drives transformation initiatives, and leads critical projects that enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.

Responsibilities:

HR Business Partnering (50%)

  • Act as a coach and HR subject matter expert , providing consultative support in all key HR areas (Employee Relations, Talent, Culture, DE&I) across multiple LATAM countries.
  • Execute the global HR strategy adapted to the region, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Global HR Centers of Excellence (TA, Comp & Ben, Learning) and the LATAM HR community to ensure consistency.
  • Support the full employee lifecycle: organizational development, workforce planning, cultural transformation .
  • Coordinate with People Solution Centre (PSC) and Shared Services to maintain governance and compliance.
  • Ensure legal and regulatory compliance across all countries (labor law, SHE, ethics, corporate policies).
  • Lead change management for organizational redesign, digitalization, and efficiency projects.

Project Management (50%)

  • Lead critical projects impacting operational excellence and commercial success in LATAM: HRBP process standardization, Talent & Development initiatives, DE&I, engagement, TA internalization, PSC optimization.
  • Design and execute project plans with clear milestones, ensuring smooth transitions and alignment with HR strategy.
  • Collaborate with PSC to harmonize processes (onboarding, payroll, HRIS) across countries.
  • Drive continuous improvement to reduce costs, improve quality, and increase efficiency.
  • Ensure all project activities comply with legal, regulatory, and internal reporting requirements
  • Manage HR KPI Dashboard and support people strategy review.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or related fields.
  • Advanced English (mandatory); Portuguese is a plus.
  • Experience in the pharmaceutical or consumer goods industry is desirable.
  • 10–12 years of HR experience.
  • Strategic consulting experience (Big 4 or similar) for at least 5 years, followed by HR experience.
  • Proven experience as an HR Business Partner in multicultural and regional environments.
  • Strong project management expertise (PMO, agile methodologies, tracking tools).
  • Analytical skills to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Highly skilled in planning, organization, and prioritization under pressure.
  • Global mindset, cultural adaptability, and ability to influence at all levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-country projects (e.g., HRIS implementation, process standardization, Shared Services setup).
  • Familiarity with PMO frameworks and Agile methodologies, and proficiency in tools like MS Project, Power BI, and Workday.
  • Experience working in Latin America or in global/regional roles.
  • Ability to navigate diverse cultural contexts and collaborate with multiple stakeholders.

title: CONSULTOR COMERCIAL - RIBEIRÃO PRETO/SP
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Responsável pela comercialização dos espaços das lojas (SUCs: salão de uso comercial) nos shoppings de sua responsabilidade, maximizando a geração de receitas, superando as metas de redução de vacância estipuladas, substituindo operações não sadias e que não sejam aderentes ao mix do empreendimento, com objetivo de atingir ou superar o orçamento. Responsável em prospectar novos clientes com perfil desejado para atuar nos empreendimentos a serem comercializados, e apresentar a empresa e a área de mix.

DIMENSÕES E IMPACTOS DESTE CARGO

Assinatura de contratos impactando a taxa de ocupação e rentabilidade de cada empreendimento.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Comercialização das áreas vagas: prospecção de novos lojistas, análise SWOT dos espaços ofertados(pontos fortes x desafios), negociações de valores e condições contratuais com lojistas, acompanhamento após a assinatura do contrato;
  • Estabelecer contato inicial com lojista: prospecção do contato comercial referente à marca indicada pelo Mix, apresentação da oportunidade para o lojista e captura de interesse preliminar do mesmo, agendamento e realização de reuniões;
  • Negociação: Elaboração da proposta comercial (Salesforce) com base nas metas definidas pelo Iguatemi, apresentação da proposta para o lojista e negociação da mesma, ajustes na proposta comercial se necessário, atualização do status de cada negociação no sistema, envio de informações técnicas sobre o SUC e levantamento junto ao lojista de eventuais necessidades de alterações para serem aprovadas e discutidas com demais áreas;
  • Acompanhar o andamento da proposta comercial no fluxo de aprovações e, após alçadas de aprovações internas, efetuar o retorno para o lojista;
  • Fechamento: Coleta de documentação e assinatura de contrato do lojista, entrega dos documentos para equipe de operações comerciais responsável pelos inputs de dados cadastrais;
  • Acompanhamento: Uma vez assinado o contrato, apresentar o lojista à equipe de operações e manutenção, efetuar o acompanhamento da obra periodicamente de modo a garantir abertura da loja. Uma vez que a loja esteja aberta, realizar as boas vindas ao lojista e passagem de bastão para área de operações;
  • Alimentar a base de contatos de lojistas do Iguatemi (Salesforce), fazendo inputs de dados cadastrais do mesmo (completando o que é previamente enviado por mix);
  • Participar das reuniões: RECOP, Matinais com GG, Reuniões semanais e mensais de atualização de status com Gerente Regional, Encontro Anual das Áreas e Programas de Excelência como o PEXIS, entre outros fóruns.

OBSERVAÇÕES

  • Ensino Superior completo (mandatório);
  • CRECI - Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis (mandatório);
  • Superior Mediato: Diretor Comercial;
  • Superior Imediato: Gerente Comercial Regional;
  • Cargos pares na área de atuação: Trainee Comercial;
  • Subordinados: N/A;
  • Experiência prévia na área comercial como executivo/consultor comercial, preferencialmente em empresas de bens de consumo, shopping center, varejo ou imobiliária;
  • Conhecer bem os empreendimentos e oportunidades a serem vendidas (Concorrência, entorno, SWOT, etc);
  • Contar com a tecnologia para ser mais produtivo.

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.

Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

Executivo de Negócios proativo e orientado a resultados para atuar na gestão e expansão de uma carteira de clientes no mercado de mineração. Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apresentar soluções GIS adaptadas às necessidades específicas dos clientes, demonstrando benefícios como eficiência operacional, redução de riscos, melhorias em compliance e suporte a decisões estratégicas.
  • Colaborar com equipes técnicas para estruturar propostas personalizadas, PoCs e demonstrações direcionadas.
  • Monitorar o desempenho da carteira, acompanhando indicadores como receita recorrente, retenção e crescimento das contas.
  • Atualizar o CRM com informações detalhadas sobre interações, oportunidades, forecast e status das negociações.
  • Apoiar clientes em dúvidas iniciais, atuando como ponto de contato primário e facilitando a comunicação com áreas técnicas internas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Superior Completo
  • Pós ou Mestrado na área (Diferencial);
  • Inglês (Desejável).

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento sobre a legislação de concorrências públicas;
  • Experiência e participação de processos aquisitivos na esfera pública
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Conhecimento dos principais concorrentes no mercado;
  • Técnicas e habilidades para o desenvolvimento de vendas;
  • Capacidade de dialogar tecnicamente com áreas de TI e traduzir as dores do cliente em soluções
  • Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico.

Habilidades Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com gestão de carteiras de clientes ou vendas recorrentes.
  • Conhecimento básico do setor de mineração (ex.: ciclo de vida da mina, práticas ESG, cadeia de valor mineral).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM.
  • Participação em eventos, workshops ou cursos relacionados à mineração, geotecnologia ou transformação digital.
  • Inglês intermediário é um diferencial.

O QUE OFERECEMOS

SE INTERESSOU POR ESTA VAGA?

title: Microservices AI Developer
description:
As an AI Microservices Developer, you will be responsible for creating APIs that leverage

Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI models to build products and perform

business process automation tasks. You will be expected to manage your own projects,

develop them in Python, and work with the DevOps team to deploy these projects as

micro-services in a cloud environment. You will support game services, products,

games, and internal functions across the organization

This role sits on Side’s Artificial Intelligence team and reports to the Head of Artificial

Intelligence. The team serves as the hub for AI and machine learning across the entire

organization and all our brands. We collaborate on cross-functional projects that range

from internal tools to user-facing product features. You will partner with stakeholders

throughout the organization to align on requirements, set expectations, and deliver API

solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

· Develop and Architect Python-based API Microservices that make calls to LLMs and other generative models to support business needs. · Work on Python-based API Microservices that provide AI-enabled and LLM powered solutions for business needs. · Keep up with the latest LLM technologies including OpenAI, Llama and Gemini. · Understand and become the company’s expert in LLM and Generative AI API methods and Open Weights model deployment. · Work as a product manager to understand the business needs for business process automation tasks. · Turn business needs into API requirements for microservices. · Work with the DevOps team to ensure deployment of the Python-based APIs are live and kept functional. · Assist in the integration of your API microservices with other software and tools throughout the organization.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties:

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

title: Executive Logistics Manager (Goiania / GO)
description:
MISSION

Lead and oversee all logistics operations in Brazil — including warehousing, inventory management, and distribution — ensuring safety, quality, and operational excellence. Act as a key connection between local teams and the global Supply Chain organization, driving continuous improvement, alignment with global strategies, and compliance with company standards and legal requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure a safe work environment by promoting a proactive safety culture, full compliance with regulations, and adherence to company HSE policies.
  • Guarantee product quality and integrity throughout the logistics flow, ensuring compliance with global and local quality standards.
  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team, fostering engagement, accountability, and high performance.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, service level, and cost efficiency.
  • Oversee warehouse organization, inventory control, and material flow to ensure high accuracy and efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyze logistics performance indicators (KPIs), identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Implement Lean and Operational Excellence methodologies to standardize processes and eliminate waste.
  • Ensure compliance with all internal procedures, audits, and applicable legal requirements.
  • Promote a culture of teamwork, discipline, and ownership across all levels of the operation.
  • Coordinate the annual physical inventory and cycle count program, ensuring accuracy and traceability.
  • Manage logistics budgets, ensuring cost optimization and alignment with business objectives.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Planning, Manufacturing, Customer Service, Finance, HSE, and Quality) to ensure seamless end-to-end operations.
  • Participate in global and regional logistics meetings to share results, best practices, and strategic plans.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, or related fields.
  • Advanced or Fluent English – frequent interaction with global teams and stakeholders.
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven leadership experience in warehouse and inventory operations within medium or large companies.
  • Strong background in logistics operations, process optimization, and performance management.
  • Demonstrated leadership in Safety, Quality, and Continuous Improvement .
  • Experience working in multinational environments and leading large operational teams.
  • Proficiency in SAP, WMS systems, and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) .
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal abilities.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, being consistently present in operations alongside the team and identifying opportunities for improvement and development
  • Intellectual curiosity;
  • Agile, creative, and innovative;
  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on spirit, with fast execution;
  • Ability to go beyond, delivering impactful results;
  • Capacity to build and engage teams quickly and effectively;
  • Strong team spirit and collaboration.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.

Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
What is Teachable?

From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is this role?

Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. We’re looking for an FP&A analystwith a strong sense of ownership who can assess the opportunities ahead of us and help Teachable make sound business decisions. This position reports to the FP&A Manager and will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, with an emphasis on financial reporting, forecasting, cross-department partnerships, and data integrity,

You will have full visibility of Teachable’s P&L focused on labour spend, and build reports to monitor our labour financial performance and help identify opportunities. You will be responsible for deeply understanding and managing the labour model, labour KPIs, unit economics and forecasting models.

If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models and are passionate about the creator economy, we want you on our Finance team at Teachable!

What You’ll Do:

  • Own Teachable Monthly Labour process, including updating actuals and forecasts;
  • Support the buildup of labour-related Balance Sheet accounts and Cash Flow statements and own the monthly updates and analyses.
  • Collaborate with HR and various teams on workforce planning, analyzing financial data, and develop actionable insights.
  • Own labour reporting package consolidated by our FP&A team and sent to our parent company, Hotmart, on a monthly basis.
  • Be the focal point for all labour cost data and partner closely with HR team to develop reports and dashboards for financial and other business needs.
  • Provide continuous improvements on tools and analysis methodologies, elevating visibility to key stakeholders.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields (Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Accounting)
  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A, Business Operations or HR Finance Business Partner
  • Strong modeling (Excel) skills
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and to analyze a big volume of data and support on reporting results to senior leadership
  • Strategic data analysis, BI tooling, SQL and database experience (Sigma) a plus
  • Excited to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Desenvolver uma equipe de talentos, potencializando seu resultado a partir da excelência na execução, melhor experiência para os usuários, estratégias comerciais e um excelente clima.
  • Colaborar para o desenvolvimento da proposta de valor e estratégia do segmento.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Ter experiência consistente de vendas em empresas adquirentes ou de entregas porta a porta.
  • Conhecer profundamente a região de atuação;
  • Experiência consistente em liderar equipes comerciais;
  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário;
  • Estar disponível para trabalhar na região de atuação: Goiânia - GO

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

No Mercado Livre, trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferentes perspectivas. Isso se traduz em Gênero, Religião, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQ+, Etnia e diversidade de experiências. Trabalhamos todas as nossas vagas com base nessa premissa. Faça parte do nosso time!

title: Information Technology Procurement, Corp IT
description:
Corporate IT is the backbone of our business. Our team helps the company to develop a competitive advantage through defining our technology objectives, assessing solution options, and devising technical solutions that help us achieve both strategic goals and meet operational requirements. As a part of our team, you’ll help deliver seamless IT experiences and support to our internal employees by providing responsive helpdesk service, stable networks and reliable IT systems.

As a procurement associate at Corporate IT, you will be responsible for IT products procurement to support various business units. You will serve as the primary interface and act as process owner responsible for managing suppliers and internal customers. In this position, you will play a key role in procuring high-quality and cost-efficient supplies for the organization. You will follow procurement procedures, maintain an updated list of inventory and incoming IT purchases and supplies.

Job Description:

  • Following and enforcing the company's procurement policies and procedures
  • Managing inventories and maintaining accurate purchase and pricing records.
  • Maintaining and updating supplier information such as qualifications, delivery times, product range.
  • Researching and evaluating prospective suppliers
  • To source, negotiate and establish purchases for IT goods and services
  • Work with IT technical team and HQ procurement team to propose good solutions from commercial perspective, ensure out-coming high quality products/supplies

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree of business administration, accounting or related field is preferred
  • Knowledge of commercial relationship build-up and procurement techniques/process
  • Experience in negotiations and networking
  • Strong analytical skill, accurate and precise attention to details
  • Ability to multitask, priorities, and manage time efficiently
  • Good resource of supplier solutions is added advantage
  • Work experience in IT Suppliers/IT industry is added advantage
  • Initiative, enthusiasm and willingness to learn in a fluid and fast-paced environment
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively at all levels and with HQ Procurement team

title: Data Product Manager - Lending & Pay Later
description:
Role Summary:

We are looking for a Data Product Manager to build and manage the data ecosystem powering our lending and pay later products . The ideal candidate will have experience in micro-lending or digital credit platforms , with a deep understanding of how data flows through the lending lifecycle — from origination to repayment.

You will define how data is collected, structured, and leveraged for credit decisioning, business insights, and AI deployment , ensuring that data becomes a core enabler for smarter, faster lending decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the data roadmap across the lending and pay-later ecosystem.
  • Map and manage all data sources involved in the credit lifecycle (KYC, transaction, repayment, behavioral, and bureau data).
  • Design and optimize data pipelines that support credit scoring, risk modeling, and AI systems.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to ensure data integrity, accessibility, and usability .
  • Define data requirements for new products, features, and risk models.
  • Build dashboards and metrics to monitor portfolio performance and business health.
  • Enable AI and ML model deployment by ensuring high-quality, structured, and real-time data availability.
  • Partner with compliance and BI teams to ensure data governance and regulatory alignment.

Key Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in data or product management roles within lending, BNPL, or fintech ecosystems .
  • Strong understanding of credit data, decision engines, and lending workflows .
  • Experience with data platforms, APIs, and BI tools (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Power BI, or Looker).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML use cases in credit risk, collections, and personalization .
  • Strong analytical mindset with ability to translate business needs into scalable data solutions.
  • Proven cross-functional collaboration skills with product, data, and risk teams.

title: CONSULTOR COMERCIAL - ALPHAVILLE
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Responsável pela comercialização dos espaços das lojas (SUCs: salão de uso comercial) nos shoppings de sua responsabilidade, maximizando a geração de receitas, superando as metas de redução de vacância estipuladas, substituindo operações não sadias e que não sejam aderentes ao mix do empreendimento, com objetivo de atingir ou superar o orçamento. Prospecção de novos clientes com perfil desejado para atuar nos empreendimentos a serem comercializados, e apresentar a empresa e a área de mix.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Comercialização das áreas vagas: prospecção de novos lojistas, análise SWOT dos espaços ofertados, negociações de valores e condições contratuais com lojistas, acompanhamento após a assinatura do contrato;
  • Estabelecer contato inicial com lojista: prospecção do contato comercial referente à marca indicada pelo Mix, apresentação da oportunidade para o lojista e captura de interesse preliminar do mesmo, agendamento e realização de reuniões;
  • Negociação: Elaboração da proposta comercial (Salesforce) com base nas metas definidas pela Iguatemi, apresentação da proposta para o lojista e negociação da mesma, ajustes na proposta comercial se necessário, atualização do status de cada negociação no sistema, envio de informações técnicas sobre o SUC e levantamento junto ao lojista de eventuais necessidades de alterações para serem aprovadas e discutidas com demais áreas;
  • Acompanhar o andamento da proposta comercial no fluxo de aprovações e, após alçadas de aprovações internas, efetuar o retorno para o lojista;
  • Fechamento: Coleta de documentação e assinatura de contrato do lojista, entrega dos documentos para a equipe de operações comerciais responsável pelos inputs de dados cadastrais;
  • Acompanhamento: Uma vez assinado o contrato, apresentar o lojista à equipe de operações e manutenção, efetuar o acompanhamento da obra periodicamente de modo a garantir abertura da loja;
  • Uma vez que a loja esteja aberta, realizar as boas vindas ao lojista e passagem de bastão para área de operações.;
  • Alimentar a base de contatos de lojistas do Iguatemi (Salesforce), fazendo inputs de dados cadastrais do mesmo (completando o que é previamente enviado por mix);
  • Participar das reuniões: RECOP, Matinais com GG, Reuniões semanais e mensais de atualização de status com Gerente Regional, Encontro Anual das Áreas e Programas de Excelência como o PEXIS, entre outros fóruns.

OBSERVAÇÕES:

  • Ensino Superior completo (mandatório);
  • CRECI - Conselho Regional de Corretores de Imóveis;
  • Superior Mediato: Diretor Comercial;
  • Superior Imediato: Gerente Comercial Regional;
  • Cargos pares na área de atuação: Trainee Comercial;
  • Subordinados: N/A;
  • Experiência prévia na área comercial como executivo/consultor comercial, preferencialmente em empresas de bens de consumo, shopping center, varejo ou imobiliária;
  • Conhecer bem os empreendimentos e oportunidades a serem vendidas (Concorrência, entorno, SWOT, etc);

A Seguradora para um mundo em mudança

Somos líder mundial em alianças do setor de bancasseguros e seguros de proteção de crédito, com presença em 30 países e posições fortes em três regiões: Europa, Ásia e América Latina. Com mais de 9.000 mil funcionários no mundo todo.

Oferecemos soluções inovadoras por meio de parcerias estratégicas em setores como Bancos, Auto, Varejo e Digital, somos referência em seguros massificados no país. Temos a missão de potencializar nossas parcerias porque, por meio delas, protegemos brasileiros. Faremos isso com uma Proposta de Valor sólida, escalável e sustentável, assegurada por times protagonistas e engajados, sob uma cultura de alta performance.

Venha trabalhar com a gente e vamos, juntos, tornar os seguros mais acessíveis à população brasileira!

title: Senior Sales Executive (Freight Forwarder / NVOCC)
description:
About Seafrigo

We are Seafrigo, a global French logistics company with over 40 years of experience, specialized in temperature-controlled logistics, focused in the food industry.

With our global headquarters in Le Havre, France, we operate across all five continents through 26 offices, with a strong presence in the world’s leading perishable cargo markets, delivering tailored and reliable solutions to our customers worldwide.

About the Position

We are looking for a Sales Executive to join our team in Brazil, based in Santos, SP, supporting our commercial activities in the Southeast region and supporting the growth of our business. This role provides the opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment, with a strong focus on results and professional development.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for building and maintaining a strong sales pipeline. You will do so by identifying key business opportunities and segmented prospects. Your goal will be to meet or exceed our annual quota and increase our revenue.

Responsibilities

  • Manage, maintain, and expand the client portfolio, focused on long-term relationships.
  • Identify new business opportunities through active prospecting and field visits.
  • Lead commercial negotiations, including proposal preparation and sales strategy definition.
  • Develop the refrigerated cargo (reefer) client portfolio in line with the Commercial Manager’s strategic direction.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs and events, representing the company and expanding professional networks.
  • Update and monitor weekly and monthly sales reports, ensuring control of key commercial KPIs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Foreign Trade, International Relations, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Valid driver’s license (Category B) and availability for client and external visits.
  • Proven experience in field sales and/or commercial support, preferably within freight forwarders or NVOCCs.
  • Strong understanding of the perishable cargo market, especially fruits and proteins.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Consultative, strategic, and results-driven profile.
  • Advanced English proficiency to work in an international environment.
  • Previous commercial experience with Freight Forwarders or NVOCCs in the refrigerated (reefer) cargo segment.
  • An established client portfolio.
  • Passion for logistics solutions focused on refrigerated cargo transportation.
  • Knowledge of dry cargo is an advantage. This role also offers opportunities to develop sales and volumes in this segment.

Benefits We Offer

  • Ticket Refeição / Alimentação
  • Vale Transporte
  • Health and dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Performance-based bonus
  • Hybrid position
  • Positive and supportive work environment

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

— Atuar no desenvolvimento de sistemas em Java, contribuindo em um projeto estratégico previsto para 2026.

— Interagir diariamente com times de outros países, participando de discussões técnicas e alinhamentos globais.

— Familiaridade com conceitos de mensageria.

— Proatividade, boa comunicação, dinamismo e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.

— Profissionais preferencialmente mais jovens, com energia, excelente postura e vontade de crescer (pleno).

title: Sales Training Lead
description:

A Simplot é uma verdadeira empresa da fazenda à mesa , com operações que abrangem todos os aspectos da agricultura, incluindo produção de sementes, agricultura e pecuária, ciências vegetais, fabricação de fertilizantes, processamento de alimentos, desenvolvimento de produtos comerciais e distribuição.

• Implementar o programa anual de treinamento para novos e atuais integrantes da equipe de vendas, promovendo o desenvolvimento contínuo das competências comerciais e técnicas.

• Diagnosticar gaps de conhecimento e alinhar os treinamentos à estratégia das categorias e do negócio.

title: Técnico de Laboratorio Pleno

Suas soluções integradas para a reforma, construção leve e descarbonização da construção e da indústria, são desenvolvidas por meio de um processo de inovação contínua e promovem sustentabilidade e performance.

A Saint-Gobain Pesquisa Brasil está expandindo sua liderança científica em revestimentos avançados para vidro com a criação de nova linha de pesquisa focada em filmes finos e revestimentos.

Quer fazer parte deste Time?

Cargo : Técnico de Laboratório Pleno

Local de trabalho : Capivari - SP

Horario de Trabalho : 08h as 17h

Missão do Cargo : Ser o principal apoio técnico aos pesquisadores nos projetos de desenvolvimento de produtos, atuando como elo entre laboratório, planta piloto e áreas industriais, assegurando a execução adequada dos ensaios, a confiabilidade dos dados e a correta transferência de conhecimento entre as equipes.

Buscamos pessoas que tenham:

  • Técnico ou tecnólogo em Química ou áreas correlatas;
  • Registro ou disponibilidade para registro no CRQ (ou equivalente);
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura/interpretação de normas/relatórios internacionais;
  • Experiência em laboratórios analíticos de CQ ou P&D;
  • Desejável experiência prévia em técnicas de espectroscopia (ótica, UV, infravermelho etc), microscopia (ótica e/ou eletrônica de varredura), ensaios de envelhecimento acelerado (alta umidade, névoa salina, QUV etc) e ensaios mecânicos de abrasão;
  • Desejável conhecimento prévio em vidros e/ou filmes finos.

Principais atividades do cargo:

  • Trabalhar com pesquisadores para auxiliar em seus projetos, através do desenvolvimento de seus protótipos;
  • Acompanhar pesquisadores em testes piloto em planta e em processadores de vidros;
  • Executar ensaios de durabilidade, óticos, mecânicos e inspeções de defeitos (visual, microscopia ótica e eletrônica de varredura) em vidros com deposito de filmes finos de acordo com as necessidades dos projetos de pesquisas e instruções de trabalho dentro dos prazos requeridos;
  • Zelar pela qualidade através da execução dos trabalhos que seguem procedimentos e instruções de trabalho;
  • Quando demandado, controlar estoques e solicitar a compra de insumos e materiais necessários para o laboratório;

title: Medical Director
description:
About our company:

Werfen: Global Leader in In Vitro Diagnostics

Founded in 1966, Werfen is one of t he world's leading companies in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of specialized diagnostic instruments, reagents, process automation solutions, and data management systems that empower patient care in hospitals and laboratories worldwide.

Our solutions in Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Autoimmunity, Transplantation, and Transfusion are available in over 100 countries and territories through our direct operations and distributors. We are a team of more than 7,000 employees with an annual revenue exceeding $2 billion , reflecting our global presence in the industry.

In Brazil, we ar e leaders in diagnostic solutions for Hemostasis and Blood Gas Analysis . We have an office in Barueri (Alphaville), São Paulo , and a distribution center in Itajaí, Santa Catarina , providing our customers across the country with excellence and efficiency.

Position Summary:

The main role is to lead and execute the Medical strategy in the home country, as well as support initiatives for Latin America in a collaborative manner. The position aims to generate business demand by increasing the visibility of products and solutions through a clinical/scientific approach, influencing physicians, professional societies, and healthcare institutions, and promoting the adoption of these solutions as the standard of care, in order to achieve sales objectives.

Key Responsabilities:

  • Develop and lead the medical strategy, ensuring clinical excellence and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with executive leaders to align medical objectives with the company's vision and mission.
  • Oversee the implementation of effective clinical practices and ensure adherence to regulatory standards.
  • Participate in strategic decision-making related to the development of new products and portfolio expansion.
  • Create, validate, and effectively communicate scientific information related to the company's products. This involves translating complex scientific data into clear and persuasive messages that support the perception and acceptance of our medical products in the market.
  • Establish and maintain strategic relationships with societies, opinion leaders, physicians, laboratory professionals, and other healthcare specialists. The goal is to understand their needs, share relevant product information, and gather valuable feedback that contributes to continuous improvement.
  • Design educational and promotional plans for the scientific community.
  • Plan and execute programs and activities aimed at improving the skills, knowledge, and competencies of teams interacting with clients, such as sales, marketing, and others.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to medical professionals and clinical staff in the context of diagnostic and medical devices.
  • Participate in resolving issues related to the company's products and services.
  • Stay updated on medical advancements, regulations, and trends specific to the diagnostic and medical device industry.

Skills and Competences

  • Deep Knowledge in Medicine and Health Sciences: Expertise in relevant therapeutic areas, clinical protocols, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Planning and Execution of Clinical Trials: Ability to design, manage, and evaluate clinical trials effectively.
  • Understanding of GCP and Regulatory Guidelines: Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and local and international regulatory standards.
  • Scientific Publications and Data Communication: Experience in writing and reviewing scientific publications and in communicating research data clearly and persuasively.

Minimum Knowledge and Experience Required for the Role (education, experience, and training):

1.Education:

  • Professional with training in Healthcare areas (Medicine, Pharmacist, Chemistry, Biology, genetics or any other health sciences).

2.Experience:

  • More than 5 years of experience in the healthcare industry (pharmaceutical industry or medical device) or in medical affairs.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and applicable clinical practice guidelines, as well as the healthcare ecosystem in which the role will operate.

description:
Somos Atvos!

Na Atvos, produzimos e comercializamos etanol, açúcar VHP e energia elétrica a partir da cana-de-açúcar e da biomassa. Nossa energia vai além do negócio: está nas pessoas e no nosso jeito de ser. Descrição da vaga:

Este profissional será responsável por traduzir a complexidade da legislação em soluções práticas e eficientes, garantindo que as decisões de negócio estejam sempre alinhadas às melhores práticas de governança tributária.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Realizar estudos e simulações tributárias para otimizar a carga fiscal, utilizando cenários comparativos, projeções e análise de riscos, identificando oportunidades de economia e mitigando contingências.
  • Conduzir estudos de modelagem tributária para novos projetos e estruturas operacionais, por meio da interpretação da legislação e avaliação de impactos fiscais, a fim de definir a alternativa mais eficiente e alinhada ao negócio.
  • Analisar riscos e oportunidades tributárias em operações e processos da companhia.
  • Atuar como ponto focal das áreas de negócio, interagindo com Comercial, Novos Negócios, Suprimentos e Compliance, garantindo suporte técnico e alinhamento tributário nas decisões estratégicas.
  • Monitorar e interpretar mudanças na legislação, jurisprudência e normas fiscais, acompanhando os desdobramentos da reforma tributária para garantir conformidade e antecipar impactos ao negócio.
  • Contribuir para a elaboração e revisão de políticas e procedimentos internos da área tributária, promovendo melhorias e boas práticas de governança fiscal.
  • Definir e executar estratégias de planejamento tributário, com foco em tributos diretos e indiretos, assegurando otimização da carga fiscal, conformidade legal e suporte técnico às áreas da empresa.
  • Profissional com experiência em análises estratégicas e modelagem tributária para novos projetos, com forte domínio em IRPJ/CSLL, PIS/COFINS e ICMS , além de visão voltada à eficiência fiscal e mitigação de riscos.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Excel (para uso de fórmulas e tabelas dinâmicas no dia a dia).
  • Conhecimento de modelagem tributária.
  • Necessário ter atuado com impostos diretos e indiretos.
  • Diferencial: inglês avançado.

Informações adicionais:

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido , com três dias presenciais por semana em nosso escritório em Pinheiros/SP. Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e conectado com o propósito de produzir energia limpa e renovável, impulsionando o futuro sustentável do país.

Na Atvos, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é essencial para transformar o amanhã . Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida dentro e fora do campo ou do escritório.

title: Chief Estimator and Industry Specialist
description:

Our AI Document Assistant, Flexible estimation engine, and Supplier Management modules further supercharge builders to mitigate risk and win new bids at scale. TrueBuilt offers unparalleled flexibility, seamlessly integrating with existing solutions or serving as a comprehensive standalone platform.

We are seeking an experienced Industry Specialist/Estimator to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming the way builders approach preconstruction.

Responsibilities:

As an Industry Specialist/Preconstruction Manager at TrueBuilt, you will play a crucial role in bridging the gap between our product development team and the needs of the preconstruction industry. 

Your primary responsibilities will include:

Industry Expertise:

  • Utilize your deep understanding of preconstruction processes, including takeoff/estimation, bid management, and qualification/risk management.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to preconstruction software and workflows.
  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify gaps and opportunities in the preconstruction software landscape.
  • Act as a subject matter expert and provide insights and guidance to the product development team.

Prospective Sales Support:

  • Collaborate with the TrueBuilt sales team to win new business and onboard new customers to the TrueBuilt Platform
  • Ability to conduct product demos for prospective customers along with industry knowledge to showcase TrueBuilt's preconstruction software and its value proposition.

Customer Engagement and Support:

  • Engage with customers, industry professionals, and stakeholders to understand their pain points, challenges, and needs.
  • Collaborate with Customer Support to identify customer pain points.
  • Provide training, support, and guidance to customers in adopting and maximizing the use of TrueBuilt's software solutions.

Content Creation:

  • Contribute to thought leadership content, including blog posts, whitepapers, and industry presentations, to establish TrueBuilt as a trusted authority in preconstruction.
  • Represent TrueBuilt at industry events, conferences, and webinars to share insights and network with industry professionals.
  • Act as an ambassador for TrueBuilt, building relationships with industry influencers and fostering partnerships.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent industry experience).
  • 6+ years of experience with OST, Quickbid & Planswift.
  • Proven experience in preconstruction roles, including takeoff/estimation and bid management.
  • Strong knowledge of preconstruction software and tools, such as takeoff/estimation software, bid management platforms, and qualification/risk management solutions.
  • Experience in product management or a strong understanding of product development processes.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to articulate complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify opportunities, drive insights, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams, bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Passion for innovation, technology, and driving positive change in the construction industry.

If you are a passionate industry professional with a strong understanding of preconstruction workflows and the desire to shape the future of preconstruction software, we want to hear from you. Join the TrueBuilt team and be part of our mission to empower builders with game-changing technology solutions.

To apply, please submit your resume here. 

Note: Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect

Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.
  • Strong background in data modelling, architecture frameworks, and modern data integration methods.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure) and tools (Databricks, SQL, ADF etc) as well as analytics solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and align across business and technology functions.
  • Experience building and evolving data & platform architectures that scale and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Passion for coaching and enabling others with a collaborative leadership approach.
  • Knowledgeable in Data Source systems (eg. SAP) and Data Lake technology
  • Stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Fluent in writing and speaking English

DESIRED:

  • Previous experience in CPG industry would be ideal
  • Experience at operating in a complex global matrix organisation
  • Experience at collaborating with cross-functional partners
  • High drive for results and an ability to work with minimum input

What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
  • An industry-competitive salary and benefits package, including a company bonus.

Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.

We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Job description

  1. The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  2. Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  3. Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  4. Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  5. Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.

Desired profile

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  2. Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  3. Knowledge in Tax reform;
  4. Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;

Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.

Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Senior Key Account Executive
description:
1. About Us

Keeta is the international arm of Meituan , one of the world’s leading delivery platforms. We’re on a mission to revolutionize how people access food and daily essentials globally. Guided by our core belief—“We help people eat better, live better” —we’re bringing innovation to the global stage and building a better future for consumers and partners alike.

2. Responsibilities

  • Responsible for managing and developing assigned accounts, supporting medium-sized chain brands to strengthen cooperation with the platform through brand marketing and promotional activities, contributing to the growth of transaction volume; executing the company’s sales strategy and supporting the achievement of sales targets;
  • Understand the business operations of the brands under responsibility based on their industry characteristics, and assist in developing and implementing food delivery solutions through basic business data analysis;
  • Maintain effective communication with the platform’s delivery team, acting as a liaison between the delivery team and assigned brands to help improve the overall delivery service experience;
  • Actively collect first-hand marketing information, user feedback, and local market insights, and provide practical and actionable suggestions to support business improvements.

3. Basic Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in account management, sales, or business development in the food, restaurant, or consumer goods industry is preferred;
  • Good negotiation and market development skills, strong goal orientation, customer-focused mindset, and willingness to take on challenges;
  • Basic data analysis skills and proficiency in office software applications; experience working with reports and charts is required;
  • High level of integrity, responsibility, resilience, and teamwork; proactive and passionate about work;
  • English is mandatory.

4. Why Join Us?

Be part of the global expansion of Meituan’s food delivery revolution. At Keeta, you’ll experience firsthand the fast-paced growth and transformation of a cutting-edge industry. Join a diverse, world-class team that encourages bold thinking and global collaboration. This is more than just a job—it’s a chance to unlock your potential, expand your international outlook, and contribute meaningfully to innovation on a global scale.

Com muitas oportunidades de desenvolvimento, você fará parte de uma equipe altamente competente e de uma empresa internacional que está em rápido crescimento que coloca a segurança e a sustentabilidade em primeiro lugar.

title: Analista de Compliance Pleno
description:

title: Desenvolvedor sênior
description:
